name: FLA_LEASE_BALANCES_ALL
description: FLA_LEASE_BALANCES_ALL contains the scheduled and accounted balances for the leases.

columns.name: LEASE_BALANCE_ID
columns.description: Unique lease balance identifier.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LEASE_ID
columns.description: Lease identifier. It references the primary key of the FLA_LEASES_ALL table.

columns.name: LEASE_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Lease detail identifier. It is referenced from the FLA_LEASE_DETAILS table.

columns.name: PAYMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Payment number. It is referenced from FLA_LEASE_PAYMENT_HEADERS  table.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the lease payment.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Regime code. This drives the accounting model and reporting for the lease.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifier as defined in general ledger.

columns.name: BALANCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of balance being maintained. Possible values would be Scheduled, Accounted in Lease Accounting and Final Accounted.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period name of the accounting period.

columns.name: PERIOD_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the accounting period.

columns.name: PERIOD_END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the accounting period.

columns.name: OPENING_LIABILITY_AMOUNT
columns.description: Opening liability amount at the start of the period.

columns.name: BOOKED_LIABILITY_AMOUNT
columns.description: Liability booked because of bookings or amendments in the period.

columns.name: ACCRUED_LIABILITY_AMOUNT
columns.description: Accruals of interest amount done in the period.

columns.name: REDUCED_LIABILITY_AMOUNT
columns.description: Liability reduced because of amendments in the period.

columns.name: ADJUSTED_LIABILITY_AMOUNT
columns.description: Liability adjusted because of amendments in the period.

columns.name: PAID_LIABILITY_AMOUNT
columns.description: Liability paid to the vendor in the period.

columns.name: CLOSING_LIABILITY_AMOUNT
columns.description: Closing liability at the end of the period.

columns.name: OPENING_ROU_AMOUNT
columns.description: Opening right of use amount at the start of the period.

columns.name: BOOKED_ROU_AMOUNT
columns.description: Right of use amount booked because of bookings or amendments in the period.

columns.name: ACCRUED_ROU_AMOUNT
columns.description: Accruals of right of use amount done in the period.

columns.name: REDUCED_ROU_AMOUNT
columns.description: Right of use amount reduced because of amendments in the period.

columns.name: ADJUSTED_ROU_AMOUNT
columns.description: Right of use amount adjusted because of amendments in the period.

columns.name: CLOSING_ROU_AMOUNT
columns.description: Closing right of use amount at the end of the period.

columns.name: CONTINGENT_EXPENSE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Contingent expense amount calculated for the period.

columns.name: EXPIRED_ROU_AMOUNT
columns.description: Expired right of use amount calculated for the period.

columns.name: PERIOD_CLOSED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the period is closed or not.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: BALANCES_VERSION_NUM
columns.description: Version of the transaction balances.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
